extensions.referenceNotes: Generated tonal ramps are catalog references, not extra runtime palette tokens. CSS snippets are documentation equivalents of native Flutter components; Flutter source and DESIGN.md primitives are normative.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Catalog equivalent of Flutter FilledButton; runtime Flutter is normative.
components.css: .ds-primary { min-height:56px; padding:0 24px; border:0; border-radius:16px; background:#B6AAFF; color:#080B15; font:700 15px/1.2 Inter,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-primary:hover { filter:brightness(1.05); } .ds-primary:active { transform:scale(.985); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #B6AAFF; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Outlined button
components.css: .ds-outlined { min-height:56px; padding:0 24px; border:1px solid #E7E0FF26; border-radius:16px; background:transparent; color:#F7F6FF; font:700 15px/1.2 Inter,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-outlined:hover { background:#20263D; } .ds-outlined:active { transform:scale(.985); } .ds-outlined:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #B6AAFF; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Input
components.description: Raised field with explicit label and focus border.
components.html: <label class="ds-field">Your name<input class="ds-input" placeholder="Enter your name"></label>
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:8px; color:#D0CDE3; font:400 14px/1.5 Inter,sans-serif; } .ds-input { min-height:48px; padding:18px 16px; color:#F7F6FF; background:#20263DB3; border:1px solid #363B55; border-radius:16px; font:400 16px/1.5 Inter,sans-serif; caret-color:#B6AAFF; } .ds-input::placeholder { color:#AAA7C0; } .ds-input:hover { border-color:#AAA7C0; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline:none; border:1.5px solid #B6AAFF; }

components.name: Selected choice chip
components.description: Selected duration/caller; dark text on lilac.
components.css: .ds-chip { min-height:48px; padding:8px 12px; background:#B6AAFF; color:#080B15; border:1px solid #363B55; border-radius:999px; font:600 13px/1.2 Inter,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-chip:hover { filter:brightness(1.05); } .ds-chip:active { transform:scale(.985); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #B6AAFF; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Glass surface
components.description: Default content material without a backdrop filter.
components.css: .ds-glass { min-height:80px; padding:16px; border:1px solid #E7E0FF26; border-radius:24px; color:#F7F6FF; background:linear-gradient(135deg,#151A2BE6,#151A2BB3); font:700 16px/1.5 Inter,sans-serif; text-align:left; cursor:pointer; transition:transform 140ms ease-out; } .ds-glass:hover { border-color:#B6AAFF8C; } .ds-glass:active { transform:scale(.985); } .ds-glass:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #B6AAFF; outline-offset: 3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-glass { transition:none; } .ds-glass:active { transform:none; } }

components.name: Floating dock
components.description: Static catalog selection; Flutter implements the 240ms gliding lens.
components.css: .ds-dock { display:flex; padding:6px; border:1px solid #E7E0FF26; border-radius:32px; background:#20263DC2; backdrop-filter:blur(16px); } .ds-dock button { flex:1; min-width:48px; min-height:64px; padding:4px; border:0; border-radius:26px; background:transparent; color:#AAA7C0; font:500 11px/1.2 Inter,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-dock button[aria-current] { background:linear-gradient(135deg,#B6AAFF42,#B6AAFF1A); color:#F7F6FF; font-weight:700; } .ds-dock button:hover { color:#F7F6FF; } .ds-dock button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #B6AAFF; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: SOS lens
components.description: Visual catalog sample; this button sends no alert.
components.css: .ds-sos { width:220px; height:220px; border:1.5px solid #F7F6FF2E; border-radius:50%; background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%,#FB7185,#E11D48 55%,#BE123C); color:#F7F6FF; font:700 55px/1 Manrope,sans-serif; box-shadow:0 12px 32px #BE123C59,0 8px 12px #BE123C99; cursor:pointer; transition:transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-sos:hover { filter:brightness(1.03); } .ds-sos:active { transform:scale(.94); } .ds-sos:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #B6AAFF; outline-offset: 3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-sos { transition:none; } .ds-sos:active { transform:none; } }

narrative.northStar: Dark liquid glass with lilac highlights
narrative.overview:
The owner selectedthis direction on 22 October 2026. Quiet graphite content
surfaces sit beneath reflective floating controls. Lilac carries ordinary actions;
the Shakti shield and indigo identity connect the app to its existing brand.
Emergency rose gives SOS a clear, separate priority.

This is an Android task interface built in Flutter. The design supports night use,
stress and large text through clear hierarchy, readable labels and restrained
motion. Scope is `app/`; `web/DESIGN.md` governs the website. Runtime source is
normative, while this file and `.impeccable/design.json` record its reusable rules.
Frontmatter pixel values correspond to Flutter logical dp; OS text scaling applies.
keyCharacteristics: Dark graphite with a static lilac ambient field.
Bounded translucent chrome and reflective grouped content.
Bundled Manrope headings and Inter controls/body text.
A gliding five-destination dock and immediate emergency activation.

rules.name: The Emergency Priority Rule
rules.body: Keep SOS clearly labeled and visually dominant; decoration and navigation never delay an emergency callback.

rules.name: The Bounded Material Rule
rules.body: Keep backdrop filters clipped to the controls that need separation from moving content; content rows use the reflective material without a filter by default.

dos: Do use bundled fonts, shared tokens and the existing shield mark.
Do preserve 48 dp targets, semantic actions and the visible SOS cancellation control.
Do keep ordinary content legible when glass becomes opaque.
Do test narrow screens, 200% text and real populated data.
Do distinguish Flutter-rendered checks from native-device performance evidence.
donts: Don't delay emergency actions for animation, network access or optional preferences.
Don't add backdrop blur to every content row.
Don't invent contacts, readiness, delivery confirmations or map results.
Don't reintroduce the removed volume/accessibility trigger.
Don't treat static screenshots as proof of handset smoothness or Play Protect approval.
